author: Pokebeard Tcg
title: Cluck Games hiring artists for Card Collection Simulator card art
content: IM IN A VIDEO GAME!!! CARD COLLECTION SIMULATOR is officially out today! If you wanna be a vendor definitely check this game out! Cluck Games is looking to hire community artists to replace all the A.I. card art in the game. They have hundreds of cards they are looking to replace and they want to prioritize people from the card collecting community to do that. If you are interested in this please fill out the Artist Application below! Steam Link - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3353700/Card_Collection_Simulator/ Artist Application - https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc5_5q2KG67h5J99qXfCmVaYhzry-qZpRKvDTytFK2gHUN98Q/viewform

author: Geek Realm Hub
title: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator
content: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator! Dream job alert for Pokémon artists! The Pokémon Company has opened a full-time illustrator position focused on creating artwork for Pokémon Sleep. The role includes designing Pokémon sleeping poses using vector illustrations, creating in-game assets such as items, dishes, and environments, checking artwork quality, and directing external illustrators. Applicants need at least two years of professional vector illustration experience, proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, experience matching established character and IP art styles, and a background in the gaming or entertainment industry. The position is based at The Pokémon Company's headquarters in Roppongi, Tokyo, Japan. Think you've got what it takes to draw Pokémon dreams for a living? Apply: https://hrmos.co/pages/pokemon/jobs/0000147

author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!
